name: nextra-rhinogh
description: Six token-lean tools (view, query, run, gh_edit, undo, memory) for Rhino 8 and Grasshopper.
long_description: Talks to the NextraRhinoGh plug-in running inside Rhino 8 over 127.0.0.1 with a per-session token. Install the Nextra-RhinoGh Yak package in Rhino first.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: full = all 6 tools, ask = read-only (view + query)

tools.name: view
tools.description: Grid image with handle tags of Rhino or the GH canvas

tools.name: query
tools.description: Text answers: Rhino objects, GH shorthand, components, docs, library, status

tools.name: run
tools.description: Run Python 3 / C# in Rhino with delta + checkpoint

tools.name: gh_edit
tools.description: Shorthand diff edits of the Grasshopper canvas
